description: Phase 4: multi-map system (one dimension per map JSON), deterministic ForzaChunkGenerator, road network planner, first map 'Xu Rong' radius 12000 (Q3 default) with all required Vietnamese-inspired regions, anti-sparseness stats + preview PNG, >=8 Racing and >=3 Dirt routes, pregen command, DH compat. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Read .agents/inbox.md, then implement plan.md items 4.1-4.6 in order exactly as written in /projects/sandbox/Forzacraft/.agents/tasks/forzacraft/plan.md (files, behaviour, verification per item).
After each completed item: run its Verify command, then git add the specific files, commit (conventional message) and git push origin main.
Any point needing a user decision: append a question to .agents/questions.md, send_message severity 'info', mark the item DEFERRED (Qn) in plan.md, continue with other items.

Finish with the Phase 4 DONE CHECK: bash tools/ci/done-check.sh (and COMPAT=server bash tools/ci/server-smoke.sh where the plan says so); record command outputs summary, test counts, screenshot paths in findings.
acceptance_criteria: fc map stats passes the anti-sparseness rule; preview PNG viewed
all routes resolve onto road surface, 3-15 km
COMPAT=server server-smoke passes; DONE CHECK passes
